rejected_theories.theory: DTV report was to the President through the Vice President
rejected_theories.reason: Parent section2 and the report address specify the Vice President; the charter’s Assistant Secretary routing does not change that named recipient.

rejected_theories.theory: December31 1998 reporting deadline is the submission date
rejected_theories.reason: Transmittal expressly dates affirmative submission December18; deadline is a distinct normative date.

rejected_theories.theory: DTV charter October31 duration disproves all later report submission
rejected_theories.reason: Report letter itself is dated December18; charter legal force and renewal are separate lifecycle questions analyzed in public v4 research, not silently converted into a factual nonoccurrence.

rejected_theories.theory: SpecialEducation report cover alone establishes submission
rejected_theories.reason: The letter’s performative submission language and GSA explicit reported-to-President statement establish the stronger factual basis.

rejected_theories.theory: August28 2002 print-production furniture is report-submission occurrence
rejected_theories.reason: Those are production timestamps reproduced in the PDF; the letter is dated July1 and GSA reports July1 event.

rejected_theories.theory: GSA November5 2026 export or retrieval timestamp is occurrence date
rejected_theories.reason: The current export describes fiscal-year2002 events explicitly; source-export, retrieval and occurrence dates remain distinct.

rejected_theories.theory: GSA August1 2002 administrative actual-term date is legal30day endpoint
rejected_theories.reason: Item8c records that field while item7 expected date is July31. Neither replaces report-submission date nor adjudicates civil-day arithmetic or legal effect.

rejected_theories.theory: Dated submission means actual recipient receipt
rejected_theories.reason: Contemporaneous sender-side tender is affirmative occurrence evidence but supplies no independent receiving-office acknowledgment.

rejected_theories.theory: A newly authenticated wet-paper signature is required before this documentary submission proposition can be proposed
rejected_theories.reason: No such requirement appears in existing NORTON evidence gate; held official PDF, its exact quotation and source-based review are the relevant route. Signature authenticity is not separately certified.

legal_trigger_boundaries.DTV: EO13038 sec2 report to Vice President; sec4 Committee terminates30days after submitting its report unless President extends. EO13081/13102 change only reporting deadline. Submitted fact is distinct from legal30day computation, charter analysis and whole-order first ending.
legal_trigger_boundaries.SpecialEducation: EO13227 sec3(b) prepare and submit report to President; sec4(e) Commission terminates30days after submitting final report unless President extends. EO13255 substitutes July1 for April30 reporting date. Neither July31 nor August1 legal endpoint is decided here.
